verified_facts.text: The Equinox was originally established in 1769 as Marsh Tavern, Vermont's oldest hotel and a gathering place for Ethan Allen's Green Mountain Boys.
verified_facts.excerpt: Originally established in 1769 as Marsh Tavern, Vermont’s oldest hotel and a gathering place for Ethan Allen’s Green Mountain Boys

verified_facts.text: The resort is set in the heart of Manchester, Vermont, and is a four-season destination.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in the heart of Manchester, Vermont, The Equinox Golf Resort & Spa is a historic four- season destination that blends adventure with relaxation.

verified_facts.text: The resort is surrounded by the Green Mountains and has a championship golf course, a full-service spa and year-round outdoor activities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounded by the scenic Green Mountains, the resort features elegant accommodations, a championship golf course, a full-service spa, and year-round outdoor activities.

verified_facts.text: Guests have unlimited access to 850 acres of private hiking trails at the Equinox Preservation Trust.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unlimited access to 850 acres of private hiking trails at the Equinox Preservation Trust.

verified_facts.text: The Green Mountain Suite in the Main Inn is the resort's largest suite, a bi-level one-bedroom suite with views of the Green Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our largest suite offers spectacular views of the Green Mountains and more than 800 square feet of living space.

verified_facts.text: The bi-level Cupola Suite has a king bedroom, a separate upstairs living room and 360-degree mountain views from its cupola.
verified_facts.excerpt: The bi-level one-bedroom Cupola Suite features a king bedroom, a separate living room upstairs with queen sleeper sofa, and 360 degree mountain views in this unique cupola.

verified_facts.text: The Charles Orvis Inn is a 19th-century building adjacent to the Main Inn.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the timeless allure of Charles Orvis Inn, a 19th-century gem located adjacent to the Main Inn just steps from the resort's diverse offering of activities and amenities.

verified_facts.text: The Orvis Inn has a library, a fireplace sitting room and a New England-style porch.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spacious suites, a cozy library, a fireplace sitting room, a New England-style porch, and a breathtaking setting.

verified_facts.text: Orvis Inn suites have a living room with a fireplace, a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen and a marble bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: a gracious living room with a fireplace and sleeper sofa, a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen, and a beautiful marble bath with a tub and shower.

verified_facts.text: Meadow House is a free-standing home in a quiet meadow overlooking the Green Mountains and a reflecting lily pond, on the edge of Manchester Village.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in a quiet meadow overlooking the Green Mountains and a peaceful reflecting lily pond, Meadow House —the resort’s newest addition—offers a private retreat on the edge of Manchester Village.

verified_facts.text: The Dormy House is a bi-level private home overlooking the first tee of the golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking the first tee of the golf course, The Dormy House is a spacious, bi-level retreat offering all the comforts of home with the amenities of a world-class resort.

verified_facts.text: The Spa at The Equinox has a sauna and steam room, a 24-hour fitness and yoga studio, an indoor lap pool and an outdoor whirlpool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our facility features separate men’s and women’s locker rooms with a sauna and steam room, a 24-hour fitness and yoga studio, a 25-yard indoor lap pool, and a beautiful outdoor whirlpool.

verified_facts.text: The spa uses local products and draws on elements of Vermont's natural beauty.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxury resort spa features local products & incorporates elements of Vermont’s natural beauty to create a healing, revitalizing atmosphere & strong sense of place.

verified_facts.text: The spa menu includes a Maple Sugar body scrub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in a gentle yet effective exfoliation using our nourishing Maple Sugar scrub.

verified_facts.text: The spa's Spirit of Vermont treatment, inspired by the Green Mountains, combines essential oils, massage, reflexology and Reiki.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the serenity of the Green Mountains, this signature experience features a custom blend of essential oils, therapeutic massage, reflexology, and Reiki.

verified_facts.text: The spa holds Sound Bath sessions that combine water, sound and stillness in the spa pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Drift into deep relaxation with our newest wellness experience, the Sound Bath, a soothing fusion of water, sound, and stillness in the serene setting of our spa pool.

verified_facts.text: The Land Rover Experience at The Equinox teaches expedition-style off-road driving over obstacles such as steep inclines and rock crawls.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevate your off-road skills with Land Rover Experience at The Equinox. Learn expedition-style driving and conquer thrilling obstacles like steep inclines, rock crawls, and more.

verified_facts.text: The Orvis Inn is a rustic retreat where outdoor activities such as fly-fishing and hiking are close at hand.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cozy rooms and suites with wood accents offer modern comforts, while thrilling outdoor activities like fly-fishing and hiking beckon.

verified_facts.text: The resort fee includes resort bikes for riding in town or on trails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access to resort bikes for in town or trail riding.

verified_facts.text: The resort fee includes sleds and children's snowshoes for winter.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sleds & Kids Monster Trax Snow Shoes for winter fun.

verified_facts.text: The Equinox King with Terrace in the Main Inn has a private outdoor terrace with seating.
verified_facts.excerpt: This elegant guest room features a plush king bed, private outdoor terrace with seating, and refined décor inspired by Vermont’s timeless style.

verified_facts.text: Guests must be at least 21 years old to check in.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Mimimum age to check into The Equinox Resort is 21 Years Old.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome for a nightly pet service fee, with certain restrictions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets are always welcome at The Equinox. We charge a nightly Pet Service Fee and there are certain restrictions.

verified_facts.text: Stays carry a nightly resort fee plus a Historic Preservation Fund charge and a Community Impact Fee on top of taxes.
verified_facts.excerpt: 9% Occupancy Tax + 1% Local Tax + $44 Per Night Resort Fee + 4% Historic Preservation Fund + 1% Community Impact Fee

verified_facts.text: Falcon Bar's seating area offers Green Mountain views through original windows.

verified_facts.text: Marsh Tavern has been a destination for Manchester locals and hotel visitors since 1769.
verified_facts.excerpt: A favorite destination for Manchester locals and hotel visitors since 1769, the fabled Marsh Tavern offers drinks and lite bites.

verified_facts.excerpt: Witness the birthplace of the local Council of Safety and Ira Allen's bold proposals during the American Revolution.
